runs.title: Wrapper, cover and the 1909 divider «Входящія бумаги»
runs.why: Archival cover, its lower half, and a divider sheet; nothing beyond the file's title and dates.

runs.title: Bailiff's writ against П. О. Б[артновскій] and the editor's reply
runs.why: Editors & office: the 1904 judgment claiming he was paid as assistant editor (close-read 2026-11-24).

runs.title: Cabinet official's private letter proposing a lower sale price
runs.why: Price of the Ежегодникъ; routed by Теляковскій to Дризенъ. Signature unread.

runs.title: Replies to the new editor's calls for material and copies (Moscow branch, Княжевичъ, Minister's order, Theatre Society, Гидони, Moscow Theatre School, Сумбатовъ)
runs.why: The 1909 relaunch: contributors and sources answering Дризенъ; the Minister's order on the new programme; copies on commission. Ballet: p. 15, the Moscow Theatre School's report on its 1908-09 activity (enclosure not here) — check whether it covers the ballet pupils.

runs.title: Хозяйственный Комитетъ extracts on М. О. Вольфъ's invoices
runs.why: Print runs & finances: bookseller's bills passed by the committee (Мецнеръ, Чагинъ, Медеръ, Шенкъ).

runs.title: Литературно-Художественное Общество's journal asks for an exchange
runs.why: Exchange of copies with another theatre journal.

runs.title: Moscow Контора's list of the Постановочная часть staff, for the Yearbook
runs.why: Machinists, scenery, lighting, props, wardrobe, hairdressers and fabric-dyeing workshop of the Moscow theatres, with service-entry dates; source material for the Yearbook's lists. Manuscripts: source material that went into the printed lists.

runs.title: Copies, subscription and sales arrangements
runs.why: Copies for the Ministry, subscription sheets circulated in the Moscow troupes, single-issue sales, instalments, advertisement exchange, list of named copies. Ballet: p. 31, Moscow subscription sheets circulated in the drama, opera and ballet troupes.

runs.title: Binding quote (Гаевскій) and poster and kiosk advertising (Пташниковъ)
runs.why: Binding 1,500 copies; advertising the 1910 subscription on poster columns and kiosks, with Пташниковъ's printed lists and prospectus.

runs.title: Смѣтная комиссія resolution on the new programme's budget and the Cabinet's credit
runs.why: Print runs & finances, and the relaunch: budget of the Yearbook 'on a new programme approved by the Emperor'.

runs.title: Голике и Вильборгъ's estimate for an 8-page prospectus
runs.why: Prospectus modelled on «Старые Годы»; illustrations and printing costs.

runs.title: 1904 orders to deduct Yearbook subscriptions from artists' salaries, by troupe
runs.why: Who in the troupes subscribed to the XII issue: ballet, opera and drama artists named with sums.

runs.title: Дризенъ's report to the Director on the first months of the relaunch
runs.why: Subscribers and sales since May 1909; his сотрудники Головинъ, Чичаговъ, Бутыльникова; holiday bonuses.

runs.title: 1910 incoming papers, Jan–Mar: office, post, recommendations, photographs in Warsaw, accounts
runs.why: Divider for 1910, then office business: posting prospectuses, furniture for the редакція, the Empress Maria institutions' refusal to recommend the Yearbook, permission to photograph in Warsaw, advance accounts.

runs.title: Copies for Мельниковъ; photographs of artists and of scenery for the Yearbook
runs.why: Illustrations for the Yearbook: photo cards from two dramas, and scenery photographs from Moscow (opera «Золотой пѣтушокъ», ballet «Саламбо»).

runs.title: 1910 finances and distribution: advance accounts, 1911 budget, the Ministry's audit of the 1909 overspend, rail sales, binding
runs.why: Print runs & finances: the Контроль's extract on 4,959 р. overspent in 1909 and unpaid bills; forecast for the remaining issues; sales through railway kiosks; Целибѣева's binding.

runs.title: An author's bill for articles (М. Карнеевъ?), 135 р.
runs.why: Contributors: fees for articles on Каратыгина, Давыдовъ, Ермолова and others (drama).
